name: klangbild
description: Browser extension for Firefox and Chrome for editing audio and video on websites in real time

scripts.start: node scripts/build.mjs firefox && web-ext run --source-dir dist/firefox --start-url https://www.youtube.com
scripts.start:chrome: node scripts/build.mjs chrome && web-ext run --target chromium --source-dir dist/chrome --start-url https://www.youtube.com
scripts.lint: node scripts/build.mjs firefox && web-ext lint --source-dir dist/firefox
scripts.package: node scripts/build.mjs && web-ext build --source-dir dist/firefox --artifacts-dir web-ext-artifacts --filename klangbild-firefox-{version}.zip --overwrite-dest && web-ext build --source-dir dist/chrome --artifacts-dir web-ext-artifacts --filename klangbild-chrome-{version}.zip --overwrite-dest
